justiceLines.text: ★ IDENTIFIED: Wild Ramps. Broad smooth leaves, onion smell. Spring only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
👀 Vikram starts a story with "back when I was a surgeon..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
"BRING US YOUR ROCKS. THE SMOOTH ONES. THREE OF THEM. LINE THEM UP. WE ARE MAKING... ART. DO NOT ASK WHAT THE ART IS FOR."
(Aid quest: THE SMOOTH ONES — hand over 3 stone (any) Take it: answerAidQuest("accept"). Refuse it: answerAidQuest("refuse").)
⚖ Vikram blocks your path. "We need to talk about the stores. About what you've been taking." A few others are watching, not approaching. "Make it right, or leave. Your call."
(Find them and answer — pay restitution, or refuse. Attacking them answers too.)
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a gift.
[policy] refused the confrontation (justiceRespond -> {"refused":true})
⚖ Vikram looks around the fire. "The stores. The counts. All of it — in the open. There's a moot."
📓 Codex: They demanded a moot. Formal. No more hallway justice.

🔴 LIVE BREAKING NEWS! A MOOT has been CALLED! VIKRAM points at YOU — THEFT — TAKING WHAT WASN'T THEIRS! The gamblers are SCRAMBLING! Your CASE FILE is ready — check it before the fire decides your fate!
Vikram stands up at the fire, pointing. "This one. Theft — taking what wasn't theirs — and we all know it." Heads turn. 3 days until the moot. Use them.
📓 Codex: Accused of theft by Vikram. Moot in 3 days.
👀 Vikram starts a story with "back when I was a surgeon..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
Vikram calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
🔴 LIVE — THE VERDICT IS IN! The galaxy holds its breath!
Ursula counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "9 for guilty. 1 against."
A pause long enough to live in. Someone's breath catches. Then: "Guilty." Nobody looks at anybody.
The sentence is spoken low, like something heavy set down. "You pay. And stay — this time."

🔴 LIVE BREAKING NEWS! A MOOT has been CALLED! MARCUS points at YOU — THEFT — TAKING WHAT WASN'T THEIRS! The gamblers are SCRAMBLING! Your CASE FILE is ready — check it before the fire decides your fate!
Marcus stands up at the fire, pointing. "This one. Theft — taking what wasn't theirs — and we all know it." Heads turn. 3 days until the moot. Use them.
📈 your moot crowd +4 — won Lie Detector on camera (favor: 4)
Lena won't quite look at you. "Food's been moving. Quietly. Somebody's buying goodwill before the moot." They don't name names — but now you know to follow the food.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
Marcus calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
🔴 LIVE — THE VERDICT IS IN! The galaxy holds its breath!
Ursula counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "6 for guilty. 1 against."
A pause long enough to live in. Someone's breath catches. Then: "Guilty." Nobody looks at anybody.
Exiled. You leave with what you carry — nothing more. Behind you, Haven keeps its fire. Ahead: the world, which just got much bigger.
📓 Codex: Exiled (moot). Walking.
The pantry is closed to you. The book stays behind. To Haven, you are not one of ours anymore. Membership asked nothing — no presence, no check-ins. Exile is the one way to lose it.
The pantry is not yours anymore. Exile means exile — membership had no check-ins, but it had exactly one way to lose it.
